text:
lina: Quick heads up — our onboarding sampleapp is triggering duplicated side-effects when a 429 occurs during token refresh. Repro steps inlined.

lina: Steps: 1) long-running stream to /v1/chat, 2) token expires mid-request, 3) client refreshes token and retries with same in-flight request, 4) server processed twice.

sam: ugh. do we have logs or a request id for the dup so we can correlate?

lina: pasted logs (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-22T14:01:05Z] req_id=abc123 status=200 body="ok"\n[2026-03-22T14:02:10Z] req_id=abc123 status=429 note="quota"\n[2026-03-22T14:02:11Z] client: token-refresh start\n[2026-03-22T14:02:12Z] client: retry sent with auth=Bearer NEW_TOKEN req_id=abc123\n[2026-03-22T14:02:15Z] req_id=abc123 status=200 body="processed"
```

lina: notice same req_id on both success lines — client replayed same envelope while server already accepted the first.

ezra: this smells like the SDK's retry path not attaching an idempotency key, and also missing jitter on immediate post-refresh retries.

ezra: current SDK backoff: fixed 500ms then exponential, but token-refresh path bypasses jitter and treats it as a fresh immediate retry.

sam: can we mitigate quickly in sampleapp? propose adding an `Idempotency-Key` header for mutating endpoints and patch SDK to add default full-jitter on refresh.

lina: ^yes. short-term we can: 1) app-level idempotency header, 2) server-side dedupe on event_id if present. Long-term we should harden SDK so refresh doesn't blind-retry.

sam: snippet I'll drop in the sampleapp repo:
```
fetch(url, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`, 'Idempotency-Key': uuidv4() }})
```

e zra: also recommend backoff formula for refresh retries: `sleep = rand(0, base * 2**attempt)` (full jitter) and cap at 10s. ensures distributed retries.

lina: good. one more edge: streaming/resume cases — we need the SDK to signal "safe-replay-window" per request so hosts can dedupe transient duplicates during resume flows.

sam: agreed. maybe add header `X-Redwood-Safe-Replay` with a timestamp/version blob the server understands. fallback: server keeps a short-lived processed set.

devex-bot: opened ticket RW-3247: "SDK: add refresh-path full jitter + default idempotency header for mutating endpoints" assigned to @sam.

oncall-bot: alert auto-resolve noted — incident 2026-03-22-11 closed, follow-up in RW-3247.

lina: action items: sam will push sampleapp PR w/ idempotency key today, ezra will prototype jitter change in SDK branch, I'll add a short server dedupe note to the onboarding guide.

sam: will ping when PR is up, also adding a test that simulates mid-stream token expiry and asserts at-most-once processing.

ezra: if anyone hits more dupes, drop the full request packet (headers + body) into #devex and I'll triage. :mag: :shipit:
